name: Qatar Foundation
verdict: A not-for-profit foundation created by the late Father Amir of Qatar and chaired by Sheikha Moza bint Nasser. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: BAL partner since 2026 (the league's first Official Community Partner); its logo is displayed on the back of all BAL game uniforms, including Al Ahly's 2026 jersey. The foundation is a private not-for-profit led by its royal founders — no source opened names the Qatari state as owner, 5%-plus holder or board-seat holder of the foundation, so the state's kafala/migrant-worker record (already in the dataset as qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025) does not attach to it here. Worth revisiting if a Qatari state official is sourced on QF's board in that capacity.
